capabilities: Validate vault frontmatter against typed schemas (required fields, types, enums, lists)
Autocomplete field names and enum values inside the frontmatter block
Autofix missing defaulted fields and safe type coercions
List violations in a clickable side panel grouped by note
Show a valid/invalid status-bar indicator refreshed on save
extras: Not yet in the community store; manual installation from a build is required. The README documents limitations: no calendar validity checks for dates, case-sensitive enum matching, and no nested-field support.
problem: Obsidian does not check that a note's frontmatter matches required fields, types or allowed values for that kind of note, so malformed metadata goes unnoticed.
summary: Frontmatter schema plugin that validates notes against per-type typed schemas and adds field autocomplete and safe autofix.
